Hymn 264: Hark, All Ye Nations!
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: George F. Root
Lyricist/Text Author: Louis F. Mönch
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 264 titled "Hark, All Ye Nations!" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by George F. Root and the lyrics were written by Louis F. Mönch.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
